name: Protein Powder (Whey)
siboNotes: Pure whey protein isolate is generally well-tolerated by most SIBO patients. Avoid products with added inulin, chicory root, or artificial sweeteners like sorbitol and mannitol.
preparationTips: Choose whey protein isolate over concentrate for better lactose tolerance
Read labels carefully to avoid added FODMAPs like inulin or sugar alcohols
Mix with lactose-free milk or water instead of regular milk
Start with smaller portions if you're sensitive to any residual lactose
nutritionalHighlights: Complete protein with all essential amino acids
